properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (inference.rs: Read.contested_by, InferenceReading.contested_by, concluded_by_steps, proof_reading, statement_reading; reasoning.rs still_contested). A step that does not hold, but would if every premise held up only by a dispute counted as holding (and whose own gates pass), is a contested route, with the standing objections and contested Decisions behind it; a claim no route holds and one route is contested reads proof_status `contested` with what stands against each such route; a contested Decision makes what rests on it contested; a foundation taken as given under a standing objection reads `contested`; still_contested counts claims contested through their routes (disputes held open on purpose stay under contested_by_design). The cogito's "I exist" and "I think" read contested (were unproven).
properties.name: A claim no route holds while a dispute holds one up reads contested, naming what stands against each route; a given foundation under a standing objection reads contested
